==Behind the scenes==
Instant Adhesive was mentioned in "[[Free Time]]," a [[1992]] [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventure written by [[Gary Haynes]] and published in the [[West End Games]] supplement ''[[The Politics of Contraband]]'' for use with ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Politics" />
